grammar_focus: KS32 数量词与比较(as…as/not as…as、little·few vs a little·a few、a lot of·a great deal of·a great many、the same as/different from)(教材 L56 Key structures)主考;SD 易混词 handsome/beautiful/pretty/good-looking、reach/arrive in·at + 课文 break down、no less…than、过去分词作状语(辅考)
scene: 旧式汽车的比赛每年举行一次。去年有很多汽车参加了这项比赛。比赛开始之前,人们异常激动。最漂亮的汽车之一是罗尔斯-罗伊斯生产的银鬼汽车,而最不寻常的一辆则要属只有 3 只轮子的奔驰牌汽车了。该车造于 1885 年,是参赛车中最老的一辆。在好一阵喧闹的爆炸声之后,比赛开始了。很多汽车在中途就抛了锚,而有些驾驶员花在汽车底下的时间比坐在车里的时间还长。然而还是有几辆汽车跑完了全程。获胜的那辆车达到了时速 40 英里——远远超过任何对手。它在接近终点时,冲下了山坡,驾驶员费了好大劲才把车停下来。这次比赛使每个人都挺开心。它虽然与现代汽车比赛大不相同,但激动人心的程度并不亚于现代汽车大赛。

grammar_card.title: 数量词与比较
grammar_card.intro: KS32:as…as 表'和…一样',not as…as 表'不如…';little/few 含否定意味(几乎没有),a little/a few 含肯定意味(一些);a lot of / a great deal of(不可数)/ a great many(可数)表'大量';the same as(相同)/ different from(不同)。

little·few(否定) vs a little·a few(肯定)

specialRules.rule: SD 易混词:handsome(男子英俊)/ beautiful(女子、事物美丽)/ pretty(女孩、小巧可爱)/ good-looking(好看,男女皆可);reach 后直接接地点或速度(reach a speed),arrive in(大城市/国家)/ arrive at(小地方)。
过去分词短语作状语(Built in 1885 = 造于 1885 年);no less … than 表'不亚于、同样…'。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How fast did the winning car go?

passage: Once a year, a race is held for old cars. A lot of cars entered for this race last year and there was a great deal of excitement just before it began. One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost. The most unusual car was a Benz which had only three wheels. Built in 1885, it was the oldest car taking part. After a great many loud explosions, the race began. Many of the cars broke down on the course and some drivers spent more time under their cars than in them! A few cars, however, completed the race. The winning car reached a speed of forty miles an hour — much faster than any of its rivals. It sped downhill at the end of the race and its driver had a lot of trouble trying to stop it. The race gave everyone a great deal of pleasure. It was very different from modern car races but no less exciting.

stage5.stem: "He is as old ___ I am."(和…一样…结构的后半个词)
"This car is ___ fast as that one."(和…一样…结构的前半个词)
"She is not as intelligent ___ we think."(并不像…那样…结构的后半个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 她并不像我们想的那么聪明。

stage5.stem: "There was a great deal ___ excitement before the race."(表大量·后接不可数名词,a great deal 后的介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 赛前有很大的激动气氛。

stage5.stem: "A great ___ of our products are sold overseas."(表大量·后接可数复数名词的那个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 我们很多产品销往海外。

stage5.stem: "There isn't ___ whiskey left."(否定句中修饰不可数名词的'多')
"A ___ of cars entered for the race."(表'许多',a ___ of cars)
"There is ___ I can do to help him."(几乎没有·修饰不可数,含否定意味)
"There isn't much whiskey, but you can have ___."(一点点·肯定意味·修饰不可数)
stage5.stem_cn: 威士忌不多,但你可以喝一点。

stage5.stem: "There were ___ people in the shop; it was almost empty."(几乎没有·修饰可数复数,含否定意味)
stage5.stem_cn: 店里几乎没人,差不多空了。

stage5.stem: "There aren't many apples, but you can pick ___."(一些·肯定意味·修饰可数复数)
stage5.stem_cn: 苹果不多,但你可以摘一些。

stage5.stem: "My jacket is the same ___ yours."(表'和…相同',the same 后的词)
"The old race was very different ___ modern car races."(表'和…不同',different 后的介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 旧式赛车与现代车赛很不一样。

stage5.stem: "He is a very ___ young man."(形容男子'英俊、清秀')
stage5.stem_cn: 他是个非常清秀的年轻人。

stage5.stem: "The winning car ___ a speed of forty miles an hour."('达到'某速度,后面直接接宾语)
stage5.stem_cn: 获胜的车达到了每小时 40 英里的速度。

stage5.stem: "They ___ New York late last night."(到达大城市或国家时用的'到达 + 介词')
stage5.stem_cn: 他们昨天深夜到达纽约。

stage5.stem: "Many cars ___ on the course during the race."(汽车'抛锚、出故障'的过去式)
stage5.stem_cn: 比赛中许多车在跑道上抛锚了。

stage5.stem: "___ in 1885, it was the oldest car taking part."(过去分词短语作状语:被造于)
stage5.stem_cn: 它造于 1885 年,是参赛车中最老的。
